Crispy Beef Taquitos

A cheesy, salsa-rich beef filling rolled into corn tortillas, then air-fried until the edges turn crisp. Make them snack-size or fill the tortillas generously for a heartier plate.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
30 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
10

Ingredients

  • 455 g (16 oz) 96/4 lean ground beef
  • ¼ cup (25 g) diced onion
  • 1 jalapeño, diced
  • 1 tbsp (7 g) taco seasoning
  • 1 tbsp (15 g) minced garlic
  • 1½ cups (170 g) fat-free cheddar
  • ¼ cup (40 g) whipped cream cheese
  • ½ cup (120 g) salsa
  • 10 corn tortillas
  • Olive-oil spray

Amounts are scaled from 10 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Heat air fryer to 375°F (190°C). Brown the beef in a skillet, breaking it into small pieces.
  2. Add onion, jalapeño, taco seasoning and garlic. Cook until the beef is no longer pink and the onion softens.
  3. Transfer to a bowl. Stir in cheddar, whipped cream cheese and salsa until evenly combined.
  4. Wrap tortillas in a damp towel and microwave for about 1 minute, until flexible. Spoon filling along the lower third of each tortilla and roll tightly.
  5. Arrange seam-side down in the air fryer basket. Mist with olive oil and air-fry 7–10 minutes, turning once if needed, until crisp.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
